senses.gloss: ch. sameto moisten, saturate. Part. pass. מְלַכְלַךְ.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:3:3">Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מל׳ באורייתא</he> saturated with knowledge.
Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵃ top (expl. עקבת יין sediment, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:10">ib. V, 10</cite>) <he>בההוא דמְלַכְלֵךְ</he> it means that remnant of wine which soils (is thick, with ref. to <cite ref="P01151"><he>עקבה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Hosea 6:8">Hos. VI, 8</cite>).
